core.seasons.description-a-season-groups: A season groups productions under a name and dates. A new season is a draft: only staff see it. Publish it to show its name on its productions on the public site. Archived seasons leave what's on and stay in the archive.
core.seasons.description-seasons-are-opt: Seasons are optional. Use them to group productions, such as Autumn 2027.
core.seasons.name: Name
core.closures.description-times-when-the: Times when the theatre, a venue or a space is shut. A closure that blocks performances stops one being scheduled inside it.
core.closures.description-add-a-closure: Add a closure for a holiday shutdown, building work or anything else that keeps the doors shut.
core.closures.description-untick-to-give: Untick to give a start and an end time.
core.closures.help-choose-one-day: Choose one day, or a first and a last day.
core.closures.description-turn-off-to: Turn off to show the closure on the calendar as a warning only.
core.run-presets.description-start-times: Start times, each with its days, that Add a run starts from. Anyone who adds runs can save one there.
core.run-presets.description-a-preset-fi: A preset fills in a run's start times, such as evenings Tuesday to Saturday with a Saturday matinee.
core.run-presets.name: Name
core.run-presets.help-one-line-for: One line for each start time, with the days it runs on.
core.venues.description-a-venue-is: A venue is a building or site the theatre performs in. Each has one or more spaces, such as a main house and a studio.
core.venues.description-the-venue-gets: The venue gets one space of the same name. Add more on the venue's page.
core.venue.name: Name
core.venue.help-shown-on-the: Shown on the venue's public page.
core.venue.help-public-transport-parking: Public transport, parking and where the entrance is.
core.venue.help-what-to-expect: What to expect on arrival, in words. The features below are shown as well.
core.venue.description-tick-what-the: Tick what the venue or a space offers. Each is listed for visitors as a feature; a tick says it is there, and does not set a number of seats or wheelchair places.
core.venue.placeholder-note-such-as: Note, such as where it is
core.venue.description-performances-stil: Performances still to come are scheduled in its spaces. Move them to another space or cancel them first, then archive the venue.
core.venue.help-box-office-and: Box office and room bookings start from this.
core.venue.help-what-add-a: What Add a run starts from here.
core.venue.description-untick-for-a: Untick for a space several groups can share at once, such as a foyer.
core.venue.description-untick-for-a-2: Untick for a space in a building someone else runs, or one the theatre visits.
core.venue.help-a-short-note: A short note shown under the venue's directions, such as which entrance and floor.
core.seasons.delete-consequence: The season is removed. You can undo this for a few seconds.
core.closures.delete-consequence: Performances can be scheduled in this time again.
core.run-presets.delete-consequence: Runs already added keep their performances.
core.run-presets.delete-consequence-used: Runs already added keep their performances. {count} spaces use it and will start from the theatre's usual preset instead.
Runs already added keep their performances. One space uses it and will start from the theatre's usual preset instead.
core.venues.name: Name
core.venue.archive-consequence: It leaves every picker and the public site. Records that use it keep it, and you can restore it later.
core.venue.delete-consequence: The space and its access features are removed. This cannot be undone.
